sources.title: Ethereum Yellow Paper (Paper.tex)
sources.note: Normative quotes: Appendix F "Transactions are signed using recoverable ECDSA signatures. This method utilises the SECP-256k1 curve"; address = rightmost 160 bits of the Keccak-256 hash of the ECDSA public key; KEC = Keccak-256 "rather than the final SHA-3 specification"; ECREC precompile = ECDSARECOVER.

sources.title: Ethereum execution-specs: crypto/elliptic_curve.py and crypto/hash.py
sources.pin: git tag v2.20.0 = 2004296f2ffcbcebcd00f41152d33e8dfda0922a; elliptic_curve.py sha256 216673ca717b6b6fcbc4d11009ed7e5126ed9fe65021834960b68147f660480b; hash.py sha256 a91044ec31477542dfeea97c9480456146332ac64cc0a9b5150264e19bb6440b
sources.note: Executable reference specification: secp256k1_recover, keccak256 (Crypto.Hash.keccak, digest_bits=256). Also contains secp256r1_verify (P-256 precompile), relevant only to contract wallets.

deferred_sources.reason: NIST SP 800-218 Rev. 1 ipd (2025-12-17) is a draft; CRSF pins final publications only.
Document text reaches an LLM in production (OpenAI); CRSF 1.0 covers this with CRSF_INTERNAL_POLICY control CR-DOC-006 instead of adding a further standard. Re-evaluate in CRSF 1.1.
No OAuth/OIDC/federation and no passwords; SP 800-63B only referenced indirectly through ASVS V7.1.1.
